sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 4; Internal Quality Checks row 4)
evidence: Runtime facts vs the verifier launch (tests/test.sh:104-111, restart helper 160-167): entry /app/server.js (instruction.md:5; integration.md:3), start = Node 22 running /app/server.js as an ordinary user from any cwd (integration.md:3; test.sh runs setpriv uid 65534, HOME=/tmp/submission), port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (integration.md:3; test.sh probes 127.0.0.1:3000), storage SQLite /app/app.db or DB_PATH (instruction.md:5; integration.md:3; test.sh sets DB_PATH and may switch to the copy), the exact injected env set PATH/NODE_PATH/HOME/PORT/DB_PATH (integration.md:3), health GET /api/health 200 even without DB (integration.md:3; test.sh probe_ready), fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z in UTC (integration.md:7; also seed clock), seed /assets/seed_data.json imported once, restart durability, no leftover DB and no symlinks (instruction.md:5; integration.md:5; test.sh:72-83 zero on symlinks), accounts and password123 with roles (walls-and-retention.md:38-46, matching app_context.md and seed accounts). Public network posture is stated (integration.md:3) and none needs to be. Graded-vs-asked sweep of all 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual and 2 gate criteria found a public requirement for each observable: signed-out privacy and server refusal (instruction.md:7; integration.md:9), client scope and plain not-available for walls including list/thread/search/snippets/quotes/unread/mentions/links/transcripts and direct requests (walls-and-retention.md:50-52), partner-only live wall add/lift within seconds (:54), timers off/1/7/30 shown by title, exact-age boundary, edit not making younger, shortening deletes at once, never resurrect, partner-only (:58), deletion removing versions/quotes with placeholder (:60; conversations.md:9), hold scope/no delete/release applies at once/On hold mark/typed 'On hold' not a mark (walls-and-retention.md:64; conversations.md:13), case-insensitive literal search without versions and click-to-open (:68; conversations.md:17), transcript heading/generated time/threads/authors/edited/versions/placeholder/no controls/access (:70), refusal shown in place and persistent (:72), 3-level replies under parent with quote and same-matter rule (conversations.md:5), edited mark, staff earlier versions, author-only delete with confirm, stale-edit refusal keeping typed text (:9), formatting and literal markup everywhere incl. search snippets/versions/transcript (:13), copyable message links with preview/not-available and highlight (:17), @-mentions case-insensitive, suggestions limited to visible people, edit adds/removes, walled never hears (:21), per-person unread synced across tabs, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted (:25), Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (:29), idempotent resend and same-time order in thread/search/transcript (:31), ~5 s live updates preserving draft/scroll/open thread (:33), 390 px no sideways scroll (:35; covers transcript_print), restart persistence of all listed state (integration.md:5). Visual likert items (matter list with unread counts, hold/timer marks, transcript page, phone thread) grade craft of requested surfaces. Counterexample probes: a conforming alternative app is not failed by an unstated requirement (sign-out, used by signin_and_client_scope and polish refusal_in_place, is part of the identity surface implied by 'sign in as different people' in instruction.md:9 and the sign-in-only signed-out state, and the skill lists sign-in surface as a known false positive); dedupe of a lost-reply resend is stated behaviorally without prescribing a mechanism; times may use any clear format. A broken app cannot exploit an unstated runtime fact because every launch parameter test.sh uses is in the notes. Note: this is a source-level review; the raw evidence index records no full configured judge run, which does not bear on this row's statement-coverage question.
